statement: Beyond the square-root exponent for depth-three circuits. Constructs a single language in deterministic polynomial time whose n-bit membership function requires $`2^{\omega(\sqrt n)}`$ total gates in unbounded-fan-in OR–AND–OR circuits, at every sufficiently large input length. This crosses the square-root-exponent threshold for explicit depth-three Boolean circuit lower bounds.
